section.content: The invention relates to the technical field of gene detection, and discloses a gene detection device for biological gene engineering, which comprises a detection machine, wherein a movable cover is rotationally arranged at the rear side of the top of the detection machine, a detection groove is arranged at the top of the detection machine, a placing pipe is arranged in the detection groove, a fixed structure is arranged on the placing pipe, a pipe structure is arranged at the top of the placing pipe, when the sample adding gun stretches into the placing pipe to add liquid, the rubber sheet can provide resistance and the dead weight of the liquid in the placing pipe can enable the placing pipe to move downwards, the diversion needle punctures the soft film and stretches into the liquid placing groove to introduce the liquid into the water absorbing ring, so that the liquid is kept moist, at the moment, the sealing film can be adsorbed through the tension of the liquid on the surface of the water absorbing ring, and when the gland is opened, the sealing film cannot displace and is matched with the rubber sheet to form secondary sealing, so that aerosol and cross infection are avoided.

本发明涉及基因检测技术领域，且公开了一种用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备，包括检测机，所述检测机顶部的后侧转动设有活动盖，所述检测机的顶部开设有检测槽，所述检测槽内设有放置管，所述放置管上设有固定结构，所述放置管的顶部设有管材结构，本发明提供的用于生物基因工程的基因检测设备具有固定结构和管材结构，加样枪伸入到放置管内进行加液时橡胶片会提供阻力以及放置管内的液体的自重会让放置管向下移动让引水针刺破软膜伸入到放液槽内将液体引入吸水环内，使其保持湿润，此时封膜覆盖可以通过吸水环表面液体的张力将封膜吸附住，在压盖打开时封膜不会出现位移并配合橡胶片形成二次密封避免气溶胶和交叉感染。

Gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineeringTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of gene detection, in particular to gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering.

Background

In the patent application of application publication number CN216639489U, it includes the equipment body, the bottom fixedly connected with base of equipment body, the bottom fixedly connected with supporting shoe of base, the top fixedly connected with adjustment seat of base inner chamber, the bottom of adjusting the seat is provided with the lift seat, the spacing groove has all been seted up to the both sides at lift seat top, the bottom fixedly connected with lift block of lift seat, the bottom of lift block runs through to the inner chamber and the fixedly connected with movable pulley of supporting shoe, the bottom of movable pulley extends to the bottom of supporting shoe, the back fixedly connected with motor of adjustment seat, the front side fixedly connected with rotary rod of motor output, the front end of rotary rod runs through to the inner chamber of adjustment seat and overlaps and is equipped with the cam, the both sides of cam all are provided with the movable block, the equal fixedly connected with movable frame in one side of two opposite movable blocks, the bottom fixedly connected with adjustment pulley of movable frame, the bottom of movable frame extends to the inner chamber of spacing groove and the movable pulley, can be through setting up and setting up through spacing groove, can be convenient for the setting up through the slider, can the movable pulley and the setting up through the slider, can be convenient for the setting up through the slider, can the movable pulley, can be convenient for the stability.

In the prior art including above-mentioned patent, in the process of carrying out experimental operation to the stoste of placing in the pipe, the container opens the application of force and is hard or contaminated application of sample rifle and inhale the sample repeatedly, and the friction produces aerosol pollution in the liquid residual sleeve and places the pipe of placing of stoste and do not in time seal the membrane and cause splash, leak etc. and cause cross contamination, forms aerosol pollution or cross contamination influence experimental testing result.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to solve the problem that when a movable cover is opened and closed, a sealing film of a placing pipe filled with detection liquid in gene detection equipment is easy to loosen, so that aerosol cross infection is caused.

In order to solve the technical problems, the technical scheme of the invention is that the gene detection equipment for biological genetic engineering comprises a detection machine, wherein a movable cover is rotatably arranged on the rear side of the top of the detection machine, a detection groove is formed in the top of the detection machine, a placing pipe is arranged in the detection groove, a fixing structure is arranged on the placing pipe, a pipe structure is arranged on the top of the placing pipe, and the placing pipe can be matched with the fixing structure and the pipe structure for use:

The fixing structure comprises a fixing plate, a plurality of through grooves are formed in the top of the fixing plate, the through grooves are matched with the outer pipe wall of the placing pipe, liquid placing grooves are formed in the top of the fixing plate and located on two sides of the through grooves, liquid is placed in the liquid placing grooves, soft films are arranged on the tops of the inner walls of the liquid placing grooves, the soft films are sealed to prevent the liquid from flowing out, supporting plates are fixedly arranged on two sides of the top of the fixing plate, rubber pads are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom of the fixing plate, a display screen is arranged on the front face of the detecting machine, a control end is arranged on one side of the front face of the detecting machine, a gland is rotatably arranged on the top of the supporting plate, movable buckles are rotatably arranged on the front side and the rear side of the top of the supporting plate, a sealing film is arranged on the top of the placing pipe, the pipe structure comprises a top ring which is in a circular ring shape, the inner wall of the top ring is fixedly connected with the top of the outer wall of the placing pipe, an annular groove is formed in the top of the top ring, water suction rings are arranged in the annular groove, water guide needles are fixedly arranged on the front side and the rear side of the two sides of the bottom of the water suction rings, the bottoms of the water guide needles penetrate through the top ring and extend to the outside of the top ring, rubber sheets are arranged on the top of the inner wall of the placing pipe and are arranged in a petal type annular mode, connecting rings are arranged at the bottom of the fixing plate, sleeves are fixedly arranged on the two sides of the bottom of the connecting rings, a placing groove is formed in the bottom of the sleeve, springs are fixedly arranged at the bottom of the placing groove, movable rods are slidably arranged at the bottoms of the sleeves, the tops of the movable rods are fixedly connected with the bottoms of the springs, conical seats are arranged at the bottoms of the movable rods, conical grooves are formed in the tops of the conical seats, the conical groove is matched with the bottom of the placing tube.

Compared with the prior art, the technical scheme of the invention has the following advantages:

(1) The placing pipe is provided with a fixing structure and a pipe structure, the pipe structure is provided with a water absorption ring, a water diversion needle and a rubber sheet, when a user stretches into the placing pipe through the sample adding gun to add liquid, the rubber sheet can provide certain resistance, the self weight of the liquid in the placing pipe can enable the placing pipe to move downwards for a certain distance, the water diversion needle pierces a soft film arranged on the fixing structure to stretch into the liquid placing groove to introduce the liquid into the water absorption ring, the water absorption ring is enabled to be wet, at the moment, the sealing film can be adsorbed by the tension of the liquid on the surface of the water absorption ring, the sealing film can not displace when the gland is opened and closed, and can form secondary sealing to avoid aerosol infection and cross infection by matching with the rubber sheet, the bottom of the placing pipe is also provided with a conical seat capable of being pressed and rebounded, one conical seat can support the placing pipe when not in use, and the other conical seat can rebound to the initial position after the water diversion needle absorbs the liquid, so that the sealing is prevented from being influenced by a gap between the sealing film and the placing pipe;

(2) Be equipped with two curved liquid grooves of putting on the fixed knot and put the flexible membrane that is equipped with diversion needle bottom atress just can puncture in the cistern, the flexible membrane can seal fixed to the liquid of putting in the cistern when the fixed plate daily use, guarantees when taking the fixed plate and remove that the liquid of putting in the cistern can not spill, and the both sides of fixed plate still are equipped with the backup pad, are equipped with the gland that seals the time measuring usefulness of placing the pipe in the backup pad, and the gland can be fixed through movable buckle, and the gland takes place not hard up when avoiding removing or placing.

Detailed Description

So that the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the embodiments of the present disclosure are more apparent, the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present disclosure will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings of the embodiments of the present disclosure. It will be apparent that the described embodiments are some, but not all, of the embodiments of the present disclosure. All other embodiments, which can be made by one of ordinary skill in the art without the need for inventive faculty, are within the scope of the present disclosure, based on the described embodiments of the present disclosure.

Unless defined otherwise, technical or scientific terms used in this disclosure should be given the ordinary meaning as understood by one of ordinary skill in the art to which this disclosure belongs. The use of the terms "comprising" or "includes" and the like in this disclosure is intended to cover an element or article listed after that term and equivalents thereof without precluding other elements or articles. The terms "connected" or "connected," and the like, are not limited to physical or mechanical connections, but may also include electrical connections, whether direct or indirect. "upper", "lower", "left", "right", etc. are used merely to indicate relative positional relationships, which may also be changed when the absolute position of the object to be described is changed.

As shown in fig. 1 to 12, the gene detection device for biological genetic engineering provided by the invention comprises a detection machine 2, wherein a movable cover 1 is rotatably arranged at the rear side of the top of the detection machine 2, a detection groove is formed in the top of the detection machine 2, a placing pipe 10 is arranged in the detection groove, a fixed structure 4 is arranged on the placing pipe 10, a pipe structure 6 is arranged at the top of the placing pipe 10, and the placing pipe 10 can be matched with the fixed structure 4 and the pipe structure 6 for use:

The fixing structure 4 comprises a fixing plate 401, a plurality of through grooves 403 are formed in the top of the fixing plate 401, the through grooves 403 are matched with the outer pipe wall of the placing pipe 10, liquid placing grooves 402 are formed in the top of the fixing plate 401 and positioned on two sides of the through grooves 403, liquid is placed in the liquid placing grooves 402, soft films 404 are arranged on the top of the inner wall of the liquid placing grooves 402, the soft films 404 are sealed to prevent the liquid from flowing out, supporting plates 11 are fixedly arranged on two sides of the top of the fixing plate 401, rubber pads 12 are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom of the fixing plate 401, a display screen 5 is arranged on the front face of the detecting machine 2, a control end 7 is arranged on one side of the front face of the detecting machine 2, a pressing cover 3 is rotatably arranged on the top of the supporting plates 11, movable buckles 9 are rotatably arranged on the front side and the rear side of the top of the other supporting plate 11, a sealing film 8 is arranged on the top of the placing pipe 10, the pipe structure 6 comprises a top ring 604, the top ring 604 is in a circular shape, the inner wall of the top ring 604 is fixedly connected with the top of the outer wall of the placing pipe 10, an annular groove is formed in the top of the top ring 604, a water suction ring 607 is arranged in the annular groove, water diversion needles 606 are fixedly arranged on the front side and the rear side of two sides of the bottom of the water suction ring 607, the bottom of each water diversion needle 606 penetrates through the top ring 604 and extends to the outside of the top ring 604, the water diversion needles 606 are made of hard paper rods, a rubber sheet 608 is arranged on the top of the inner wall of the placing pipe 10, the rubber sheet 608 is in petal-shaped annular arrangement, a connecting ring 605 is arranged at the bottom of the fixing plate 401, sleeves 602 are fixedly arranged on two sides of the bottom of the connecting ring 605, a placing groove is formed in the bottom of the sleeve 602, a spring 609 is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the placing groove, a movable rod 603 is slidably arranged at the bottom of the sleeve 602, the top of the movable rod 603 is fixedly connected with the bottom of the spring 609, a conical seat 601 is arranged at the bottom of the movable rod 603, a conical groove is formed in the top of the conical seat 601, the conical groove is matched with the bottom of the placing tube 10.

The working principle and the using flow of the invention are as follows: when in use, a user rotates the movable cover 1 to open, the gun head of the sample adding gun is aligned with the pipe orifice of the placing pipe 10 after opening, a certain pressing force is applied after alignment to push the gun head of the sample adding gun away from the rubber sheet 608, the gun head pushes away the rubber sheet 608, meanwhile, stock solution to be detected is injected into the placing pipe 10, the thrust of the gun head in the injection process is matched with the dead weight of the stock solution in the placing pipe 10 to drive the top ring 604 to move downwards, the placing pipe 10 moves downwards and drives the conical seat 601 to drive the movable rod 603 to move downwards along the sleeve 602 and stretch the spring 609, when the top ring 604 moves to a certain position, the soft membrane 404 is punctured, the water diversion needle 606 enters the liquid placing groove 402 after the soft membrane 404 is ruptured, the water diversion needle 606 is made of water absorption material, the water diversion needle 606 sucks the liquid in the liquid placing groove 402 upwards and sucks the water on the water diversion needle 606 by the water absorption property of the water absorption ring 607, the suction ring 607 which is dried originally becomes wet after suction, the gun head is pulled out, the rubber sheet 608 is closed to form a first seal protection preferentially, the placing pipe 10 is returned to the initial position by the resilience force of the spring 609, the sealing film 8 is covered on the top ring 604 in the later detection process, the wet top ring 604 is matched with the sealing film 8 with a flat surface to form a secondary seal between the rubber sheet 608 and the sealing film 8 by surface tension, the surface tension can form a seal, the sealing film 8 is prevented from being moved by wind force caused by faster opening when the cover 3 is pressed open again, aerosol infection is caused, the cover 3 is closed in a rotating way in the final detection process, the cover 3 is firmly fastened by the movable buckle 9 after closing, and the movable cover 1 is closed again, so that the detection machine 2 can be started to perform gene detection on the stock solution, when the liquid to be tested is less and a lot of placing pipes 10 are not needed, the placing pipes 10 can be taken out from the fixing plate 401 in a sliding way according to the actual use requirement, and then the placing pipes are placed again when in use.

The above embodiments are only exemplary embodiments of the present invention and are not intended to limit the present invention, the scope of which is defined by the claims. Various modifications and equivalent arrangements of this invention will occur to those skilled in the art, and are intended to be within the spirit and scope of the invention.
